en-US.description: A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows.
en-US.longDescription: A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows. Available as a desktop app and self-hosted web console, with support for Hermes Agent, Ekko Agent, and 14 coding-agent integrations, including Claude Code and Codex. Bring conversations, group collaboration, voice, files, and devices together in one place.

zh-CN.description: 本地优先的 AI 工作区，支持多 Agent 聊天、编码和可视化工作流。
zh-CN.longDescription: 本地优先的 AI 工作区，支持多 Agent 聊天、编码和可视化工作流。提供桌面应用和可自托管的 Web 控制台，支持 Hermes Agent、Ekko Agent，以及包含 Claude Code、Codex 在内的 14 种 Coding Agent 集成。在同一个工作区中管理对话、群组协作、语音、文件和设备。
zh-CN.name: Ekko Studio
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
更新重点
- 编程 Agent 支持在聊天、群聊和工作流中选择原生模型与推理强度，并记住已选配置 (#3354、#3360)
- 统一模型选择弹窗，按服务商和模型分栏浏览，改善搜索、滚动与小屏显示 (#3355)
- 用量概览新增账号和 Profile 筛选，展示模型与 Agent 用量分布，并改善移动端布局 (#3363)
- 修复费用、Token 和百分比显示精度，以及滚动时间范围内趋势图与汇总数值不一致的问题 (#3373)
- 桌面端新增远程服务器模式，可连接自行部署的 Web UI，无需启动本地服务与内核 (#3366)
- 修复 Agent 卡片的鼠标滚轮切换，并改善列表边缘渐隐效果 (#3351)
- 修复模型输出未闭合的思考标签时，思考内容混入聊天正文的问题 (#3365)
- 修复会话分类子菜单内容过多时无法滚动的问题 (#3374)
- 修复内置 MCP 连接继承无关鉴权 Token 导致的连接问题 (#3359)
- 修复自定义服务商模型发现信息被误报为未知配置，并减少重复警告 (#3375)
- Studio 与桌面端版本同步更新为 0.7.34，前端更新日志覆盖 11 种语言并保留最近三个版本 (#3376)
What's Changed
- docs: refresh v0.7.33 README and product screenshots by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3350
- [codex] support Agent card wheel scrolling and transparent edge fades by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3351
- [coding-agents] expose native model discovery through one API by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3354
- [codex] unify Studio model selection in fixed-height dialogs by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3355
- fix(mcp): prevent stale inherited tokens in managed transports by @widechaos in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3359
- [coding-agents] select native models across chat, groups and workflows by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3360
- [usage] add account and Profile filters to the overview dashboard by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3363
- [usage] fix formatting precision and rolling-window chart totals by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3373
- fix(chat): keep leading unclosed thinking out of replies by @widechaos in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3365
- fix(chat): keep category submenus scrollable by @widechaos in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3374
- [desktop] add remote server mode for externally deployed Web UI by @onlymykazari in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3366
- [codex] accept discovered model markers and deduplicate provider warnings by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3375
- chore: prepare Studio 0.7.34 with localized changelog by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3376
New Contributors
- @widechaos made their first contribution in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3359
- @onlymykazari made their first contribution in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3366
Full Changelog: https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/compare/v0.7.33...v0.7.34
